paragraphs: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) manufactures courtroom AV equipment, including microphones, cameras, and digital mixers. The company also provides web-based software that controls the courtroom AV system and simplifies recording and video conferencing. Support runs from installation to training and ongoing maintenance of that courtroom technology.

JAVS Suite 9 is described as a web-based courtroom software platform for the age of AI and hybrid hearings. Hybrid proceedings are handled through video conferencing for witnesses, attorneys, and defendants who cannot appear in person. The courtroom AV system also connects with existing case management software, which reduces duplicate data entry.

The about page reports installations in federal, state, and local courts across all 50 states. The same page says the solutions are succeeding in government meeting rooms as well. It dates the court-specific digital recording work to more than 40 years.

quote.text: At JAVS, we believe that an accurate and accessible record helps create an open and transparent society.
